page.overview:
Who is Abigail Thanriaguiaxus?

In Summer 2025, Brand led Strike Team X to infiltrate the prison of Stabil'nyy, where many mutants were incarcerated and experimented on by Alonya Prostovich and Directorate X; they instead found only one mutant inside the facility, Angel, who, having lost his mind because of the many tortures and experiments he endured, attacked the team and killed Brand with his wings.
